questions.text: Do you have capacity to start in Wynnum now, and how soon after his budget is allocated?
Which local team and office would serve him, and how many clients do you currently support in 4178/4179?
What happens between agreement and first service — initial assessment visit, who attends, how long?
Can you provide services privately or via CHSP while he waits for his budget?
If he is transitioning from another program or provider, how do you manage the handover and any unspent funds?
Who will be his care partner, what are their qualifications, and how many clients do they carry?
How often will the care partner contact him and visit in person?
How do you build the care plan with him and family, and how often is it reviewed?
How do you use the 10% care-management allocation — what activities, and how is it reported?
How do you respond when his needs change quickly, e.g. after a hospital stay? What is the turnaround for a plan change or reassessment request?
Can you commit to a small, consistent team of named workers? What percentage of visits are by his regular workers?
How do you handle worker leave and sickness — notice to him, introductions to replacements?
Are workers employed or contractors/platform workers? What training and screening do they have?
Can he choose worker gender, and can he decline a worker without penalty?
What is your worker turnover rate in the bayside area?
What notice is given for late arrivals, and what is your missed-visit rate?
Do you deliver nursing with your own RNs/ENs, or subcontract? Who is clinically accountable?
How do you manage medications — prompting, administration, Webster packs, liaison with the pharmacist and GP?
What is your approach to falls prevention, continence, skin integrity and wound care?
Which allied health disciplines do you provide in-house versus refer out, and at what rates?
What after-hours cover exists — is there a 24/7 number answered by a clinician?
Can you deliver end-of-life care at home if needed, and how does the End-of-Life Pathway work with you?
How do you detect and respond to cognitive decline or mental-health deterioration?
What veteran-specific or trauma-informed training do your workers and care partners receive?
How many veterans with PTSD do you currently support, and can you describe how you adapted care for one?
How will you record his triggers and preferences so every worker follows them?
How do you handle a client who becomes distressed or agitated during a visit? What is your escalation path?
Will you liaise with his treating psychologist/psychiatrist or Open Arms counsellor, with his consent?
Can social support connect him with veteran communities (RSL, Legacy, men's sheds, peer groups) locally?
Are you also a Veterans' Home Care or DVA community nursing provider?
How will you coordinate Support at Home with his DVA services so nothing is duplicated and his budget is preserved?
Which services would you recommend he takes through DVA instead of the Support at Home budget?
Do you have experience working with DVA on his contribution assessment and any reassessment?
Will you help him access Gold/White Card-funded items (aids, allied health, transport to treatment) outside the budget?
Provide your full current price list and confirm the rates in his agreement will match it.
Confirm there are no separate travel, admin, package-management, exit or establishment fees.
What mark-ups apply to purchased items, consumables, subcontracted services and home modifications?
How often do you change prices, how much notice do you give, and how were prices changed in the past year?
What minimum visit length applies, and how are short visits rounded?
What are your evening, weekend and public-holiday rates for the services he will use?
Please cost our sample weekly plan for one quarter, showing budget drawn and his estimated contribution.
How do you apply his contribution rate, and how quickly do you refund over-collected contributions?
Show us a sample monthly statement. Does it show each service, price, his contribution and the remaining quarterly budget?
How do you prevent overspending a quarter, and how do you use any carry-over?
Can family see spending in real time (portal/app)?
What happens if his needs exceed his classification — do you request reassessment, and what can he buy privately in the meantime?
Provide a copy of your service agreement to review before signing.
What is your cancellation policy and notice period, and is a cancelled visit charged to the budget?
What notice does he need to give to change provider, and are there any charges?
Under what circumstances would you suspend or withdraw services?
How are worker-safety matters (pets, smoking, access) handled?
Which services do you subcontract, to whom, and how do you check their quality?
Can he nominate a worker or business he already trusts (e.g. a local gardener) to be engaged through you?
How do you arrange OT assessment and prescription for equipment and modifications, and how long does it take?
What coordination fee applies to AT and home modifications?
Can you arrange a personal emergency alarm and falls detection?
What do your most recent Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission audit and any compliance notices show?
How do you handle complaints, and what is your typical resolution time? Can we see your complaints data?
How are incidents reported to him and family?
What client-feedback results can you share for this local team?
How will you involve his registered supporter or attorney in decisions and reviews?
Who is the single point of contact for family, and what is the response time for calls/emails?
How do you respect his right to make his own choices, including ones carrying some risk?
How is transport priced (per trip, per km, per hour), and do you drive him to specialists across Brisbane?
Can a worker accompany him into appointments?
What group or individual social activities do you run in the Wynnum–Manly area?
What in-home and overnight respite can you provide, and with how much notice?
Do you have access to residential respite beds, and how do you coordinate DVA-funded respite?
How do you support a family carer (Carer Gateway, training, check-ins)?
Can you deliver the Restorative Care Pathway, and what outcomes have you seen?
How do you support a move to residential care if it becomes necessary — including your own homes, if any?
How do you manage hospital admission and discharge?
What app or portal do clients and families use, and what can it show (roster, worker, notes, budget)?
Do you use any monitoring technology at home, and how is his privacy protected?
